title: Skills Repository
description: Securely install, manage, and use Agent Skills in chat.
installDescription: The ZIP archive will be checked for paths, size, SKILL.md and safety notes. Package scripts are never executed during installation.
detailEmptyDescription: Choose a Skill from the list to inspect its metadata, safety notes, and package contents.
emptyInstalledDescription: Upload a compatible ZIP, or discover and safely install a Skill online.
popularUnavailableTitle: No popular Skills are available right now
popularUnavailableDescription: Refresh or switch the source and try again.
externalReadOnly: This Skill comes from {{source}}'s local directory. MisakaX uses it on demand when selected and never copies, disables, or deletes the source files.
author: Author
fileTreeDescription: Relative package paths, file types, and sizes.
fileTreeUnavailable: This installed Skill has no files available to inspect.
fileTreeUnavailableRemote: Registry metadata is available, but package files could not be previewed.
previewUnavailable: SKILL.md is not available to preview.
previewUnavailableRemote: Registry metadata is available, but SKILL.md could not be previewed.
riskScripts: Contains scripts; installation does not run them.
riskBinary: Contains binary files; review the source before use.
riskTools: Declares tool permissions; runtime policy still applies.
noRisk: No archive contents need an additional notice.
uploadDialogDescription: Only ZIP archives are accepted. Paths, sizes, SKILL.md and risks are checked before installation; package scripts are never executed.
replaceNotice: A same-named Skill is atomically replaced only after validation; the old version remains if replacement fails.
uninstallDescription: This removes local files and the repository inventory. Historic turn selections remain, but cannot invoke this Skill again.
modelscopeDescription: Enter owner/skill or its ModelScope Skills URL. The archive receives the same safety inspection.
remoteUnavailable: This source is unavailable; the next available source was tried.
selectFileToPreview: Select a file on the left to view its contents.
binaryPreviewUnavailable: Binary files cannot be previewed inline.
encodingPreviewUnavailable: This text encoding is not supported for inline preview.
remoteFilesRequireInstall: Package files are not downloaded for ordinary remote details. Install or explicitly scan the Skill to inspect its artifact.
scanPlaceholder: The structured scan contract is ready. Full findings and rescanning arrive with the S3 scanner phase.
remoteSecurityMetadata: Only registry safety metadata is shown. Ordinary detail viewing does not download the package.
